newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 25.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - National assembly to extend session to finalise constitutional amendments.
Torrential rains cause heavy crop damage.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Dominican Republic, one of Taiwan's only 30 allies, will exchange financial representative offices with Taipei's arch rival Beijing.
National Taiwan University professor urges national assembly to abandon constitutional amendments.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Central bank says will not lower banks' reserve requirements.
Singapore elder statesman Lee Kuan Yew says confident about Hong Kong's future under Beijing rule.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Hsinchu science park suffers brief power outage.
Central bank pours T$20 billion into banking system to alleviate tight liquidity.
